x: Members will be interested to know that the sum of 5 guineas was given by the club to the Mayor of Westminster's Flood Relief Fund. We must thank Mrs. Ricketts for having sent along the club mascot.
Our guest of the evening was, of course, Mrs. Ricketts, and it was quite evident that she was very pleased to be among us once again, and to see us carrying on the good work.
Our chief guest was, of course, Mrs. Ricketts, whose husband did so much for our Club a few years back and sowed the seed from which we are now reaping the benefit.
